title: Human Resources Management HRM
overview: Course Overview: The "HR Management Course" is designed to equip participants with a comprehensive understanding of the key functions within a modern HR department, emphasizing the role of knowledge as a gateway to engagement. This course covers essential HR fundamentals, the latest trends, and strategies for effectiveness. Whether you're looking to deepen your HR expertise, specialize in a specific HR area, or pursue an HR business partner role, this course offers a solid foundation.
audience: This course is ideal for HR professionals and individuals beginning a career in HR. It also serves as a valuable resource for experienced HR officers and managers seeking to update their skills and knowledge on the latest HR practices and techniques
methodology: ach day focuses on a specific topic, explored through trend analysis, skill-building exercises, role plays, and videos. Additionally, time will be allocated for discussing real-world challenges and additional topics of interest.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify key functions in Human Resources Management (HRM)
Understand the evolving roles of HRM in modern organizations
Implement recruitment and selection processes to attract and hire qualified candidates
Outline the steps in the training and development cycle
Design and manage a performance management system
Grasp the fundamentals of a comprehensive compensation management system

items.text: The evolving role of HR as a business partner
Defining candidate requirements and sourcing channels
Designing and delivering effective training programs
Differences between performance management and appraisal
Job analysis and its role in compensation
Key components of compensation and benefits systems
Job evaluation, salary surveys, and the forces shaping compensation strategies
Advantages and disadvantages of HR generalist vs specialist roles
